notes.title: Update 1.0.3 - Brazilian Portuguese added
notes.notes:
This update adds Brazilian Portuguese translation, thanks to my friends at [url=https://twitter.com/StdBlueBowling]@StdBlueBowling[/url] :)

Also, few small typos were fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 and 1.0.2
notes.notes:
"Day-Three Patch"

v1.0.1
- corrected English typos and misspellings.
- fixed few scenes errors (speaking character and visuals)
- corrected Polish typos, misspellings and translation errors.

Thanks to everyone for reporting errors, if there's something more, please let me know!

__________________
v1.0.2
- corrected more Polish typos, misspellings and translation errors.

Again, thank you very much for reporting issues!

notes.title: NEKOKORO - Upcoming game!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021355/a1b6a7c4cb02efc3558ae5e84ee211a7cb37b381.png[/img]
I'm happy to announce that my new game - NEKOKORO - is close to release!
There are still few things to finish and test, but hopefully [b]it will be ready around October 2018[/b] :)
The game will be available on Windows, Linux and Mac, in English, Deutsch, Polish and Simplified Chinese!
In the meantime, check the Steam Store page for details, add to your wishlist and click follow!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/857470/NEKOKORO
